name: The Digital Church Platform
shortDescription: A UK church-administration platform from GIGCMO Limited offering parish websites, visitation documents, role-compliance workflows and a digital repository.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a module-based UK administration platform
Parishes or diocesan teams managing visitation and role-compliance documentation
Churches needing a supplier-managed parish website alongside document workflows

pricing.summary: The supplier offers a free demo but does not publish package prices in the reviewed material. Obtain a written proposal covering selected modules, implementation, support, hosting, VAT, renewal and data-migration costs.

tiers.label: Platform modules
tiers.detail: Visitation Documents Management, Role Compliance, Digital Repository and Managed Parish Website

gdprInformation: The platform links to a privacy policy, but the current document could not be retrieved during this review. Obtain the current privacy notice, data-processing agreement, controller/processor roles, hosting location, sub-processors, retention, access controls and incident arrangements before uploading church or safeguarding-related records.

uk-operator.value: The platform terms identify The Digital Church Platform as a trading name of company number 10415269; Companies House identifies that company as GIGCMO Limited.

product-scope.value: The supplier publishes modules for visitation documents, role compliance, a digital repository and a managed parish website.

safeguarding-scope.value: The supplier describes Role Compliance as focused on roles and responsibilities and says it has a strong focus on safeguarding. The reviewed material does not establish that it manages safeguarding cases or replaces professional safeguarding advice.

pricing-and-data.value: Public pricing, support commitments, hosting detail and current processor documentation were not established in the reviewed material.

editorial.assessment: The Digital Church Platform is a UK module-based product aimed at parish administration and digital transformation. Its published scope is more specialised than an all-purpose church database: visitation documents, role compliance, a document repository and a managed parish website. It may be relevant to churches or diocesan teams with those defined workflows, but public pricing and detailed data-processing information were not established in this review. Its role-compliance module should not be treated as a safeguarding-case management system without direct supplier evidence.
bestFor: Parishes seeking UK-specific document and visitation workflows
Teams wanting a managed parish website alongside administration modules
Organisations prepared to procure through a scoped supplier proposal
strengths: Named active UK company and public company number
Clearly defined modules rather than a vague general-purpose offer
Specific parish website, document and role-compliance use cases
limitations: No public price, support or implementation information was found
Obtain DPA, hosting, sub-processor, retention, backup and exit documentation before importing records
The safeguarding-related claim concerns role compliance; it does not establish safeguarding-case management
Confirm content, document and website export arrangements before contract

procurementVerdict.problem: Fragmented parish documents, compliance workflows and public-web presence
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK product combining specialised visitation and role-compliance modules with a managed parish website
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Demonstrate the exact role, visitation and document workflows with realistic parish data, then agree data-processing, migration, permissions and exit terms in writing
